UserProfile.title: User Profile
UserProfile.description: Stores public information about a user.

bio.description: A short biography of the user.

photoURL.description: Data URI of the user's profile picture.

coverImage.description: Data URI of the user's profile cover image.

motto.description: A short motto or quote for the user's profile.

following.description: A list of user IDs that this user is following.

followers.description: A list of user IDs that are following this user.

JournalEntry.title: Journal Entry
JournalEntry.description: Represents a single journal entry made by a user.

title.description: The title of the journal entry.

content.description: The main content of the journal entry.

mood.description: The user's mood at the time of writing.

isPublic.description: Whether the entry is visible to the community.

authorId.description: The ID of the user who wrote the entry.

authorName.description: The name of the user who wrote the entry.

authorPhotoURL.description: The profile picture URL of the author.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the entry was created.

likeCount.description: The number of likes the entry has received.

readCount.description: The number of times the entry has been read.

likes.description: A list of user IDs who have liked the entry.

description.description: A brief description of the channel.

creatorId.description: The ID of the user who created the channel.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the channel was created.

members.description: A list of user IDs who are members of this channel.

memberCount.description: The number of members in the channel.

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: Represents a single message within a chat channel.

content.description: The text content of the message.

authorId.description: The ID of the user who sent the message.

authorName.description: The display name of the message author.

authorPhotoURL.description: URL of the author's profile picture.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the message was sent.

/journalEntries/{journalId}.description: Collection of all journal entries from all users.

/channels/{channelId}.description: Collection of all community chat channels.

/channels/{channelId}/messages/{messageI.description: Sub-collection of messages for a specific chat channel.
